messages:
Evelyn K: Hi folks, Evelyn here (first day!). My calendar shows two "New Hire Orientation" events both labeled 09:30 but one is labelled PST and the other shows as 09:30 local. The one that should be the global session has no Zoom link in the description, just an "Add conferencing" button. Which one do I join? I'm in Madrid (CEST). @Marta G any guidance?

Marta G: Welcome Evelyn! :tada: If you're in Madrid, join the orientation that maps to 15:30 CEST (global session). The regional PST one is for West Coast folks and is optional. However both invites should include the Zoom link and recording note. Looks like a scheduling bug.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Global New Hire Orientation at 09:30 ET. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/orientation/global-feb2026 Passcode: 4321. Recording will be uploaded to Confluence after the session. If your invite lacks conferencing, check the PeopleOps calendar or reply here.

Evelyn K: My invite has no passcode or Zoom URL, only "Add conferencing". Outlook web is showing both events stacked. Clicking details shows different timezone metadata (one organizer tz=America/New_York, other tz=UTC).

IT Support: Thanks for flagging, Evelyn. This is a common issue when invites are generated by different schedulers with mismatched timezone fields in the ICS. Some clients create duplicate entries. We'll normalize the ICS timezone and resend with conferenceData and the passcode in the description. Which mailing list should we resend to?

Marta G: Please resend to new-hires-feb2026 and new-hires-upcoming so no one is missed. Add a clear description header: "Global orientation (recorded). Zoom + passcode below. Recording will be uploaded to Confluence: /onboarding/recordings".

IT Support: Ok resending now. We're adding conferenceData/joinUrl and putting the passcode in both the join URL and description, and setting event timezone explicitly to America/New_York for global. New invites should arrive in a few minutes—please delete the old two events and re-add from the new invite. If duplicates persist, DM screenshots and we'll escalate.

Liam: Quick user-side tip: in Outlook web, open each duplicate -> Edit -> find the timezone dropdown and set it to the same timezone for both events, then save. That usually collapses duplicates without removing and re-adding.

Evelyn K: New invite arrived and link & passcode are visible now. Calendar shows 15:30 CEST correctly. Thanks everyone! :relieved:

Marta G: Great! Recording will be posted within an hour after the session. If anyone can't make it, book a 1:1 catch-up with PeopleOps.

PeopleOps Bot: Recording will be uploaded to Confluence under /onboarding/recordings within 60 minutes after session end.
